author: faht
body:
Made by Jiveh and Tazz.

You can find the old version here: https://avicus.net/forums/5ae0e5463

Loadout:
• Leather helmet.
• Leather chestplate.
• Leather leggings.
• Leather boots.
• Iron sword.
• Bow (Infinite).
• 3 Golden apples.
• 32 Steak.
• 64 logs.
• 64 glass.
• 1 arrow. 

Features:
• Two endstone monuments and 1 obsidian monument per side.
• TNT supplies on upper frontlines.
• Blue vs Red
• 185 iron blocks per side.
• 72 diamond blocks per side.
• Spawndrop.
• Icarus based map.

Images:
http://imgur.com/a/nexpL

Feedback is welcome.
